run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet physics simulation that loads a cube URDF and steps the simulation forward one second
load_urdf_model: load a URDF model file into the pybullet physics simulator using p.loadURDF
configure_physics_parameters: configure the pybullet physics engine with a fixed time step and gravity settings
step_simulation: step the pybullet simulation forward one time step using p.stepSimulation in a loop
get_base_position: get the base position and orientation of a loaded body using p.getBasePositionAndOrientation
